replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: There should be a substitute rank.

replies.author: Cyclops
replies.body:
I argue with this, being that there is no telling whether the "substitute" will show up to replace the main player in the match.
Basically, everyone is a sub, and everyone is a main player.
